headline: Council to act on appointments, lodging house renewals, salary schedule ordinance, a strike support resolution, and Malden River Works funding transfers.
summary: The Council will review consent agenda appointments and lodging house petitions, consider ordinances on assistant department head salaries and water bill inspections, and vote on committee reports covering finance ordinances and funding transfers for the Malden River Works Project. A tabled utility pole petition on Floral Avenue is also listed.
